title: Department of Justice News (justice.gov press releases and blog)
questions: DOJ press releases about fentanyl trafficking in 2025
how often U.S. Attorney offices announced health care fraud cases
full text of a DOJ press release

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (JSON, 50 records per page; save under the name shown) and upload the files. Without the links: search https://www.justice.gov/news (filters for type, component, topic and date), then copy the titles, dates and URLs into a CSV with columns title,date_iso,component_names,url and upload it.

cache.why: New releases appear daily; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: Press releases are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105; justice.gov legal policies, https://www.justice.gov/legalpolicies); photos or quoted third-party material in a release may not be.

citation: U.S. Department of Justice, {dataset}, justice.gov News API (api/v1), retrieved {retrieved_long}.

audit_hooks.why: DOJ News is a set of announcements, not a statistical series; a report that counts releases must say it counts announcements.

clarify: Which period and which title words? The API filters by title words and by single day only; a range is filtered after download.
Press releases or blog entries? Releases cover enforcement actions; the blog covers policy and programs.
